newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks leap to 4.84 pct close,foreign buying.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks leap to 4.84 pct close,foreign buying.

text.p: Thai stocks soared 4.84 percent at the close on Thursday as foreign investors bought blue chip bank and telecommunications issues for mainly technical reasons, traders said.
The SET Index ended 23.99 points or 4.84 percent higher to 520.02. The SET 50 added 2.31 points, or 6.61 percent, to 37.60 in trade worth 6.56 billion baht.
